links.outcome: Safety classification of chatbot responses on pediatric burn first aid and care
links.effect: Safe in 33/36 ChatGPT (91.7%), 31/36 Gemini (86.1%), 30/36 DeepSeek (83.3%), 29/36 Doubao (80.6%); some potentially unsafe responses.
links.quote: Responses were classified as safe in 33 of 36 cases for ChatGPT (91.7%), 31 of 36 for Gemini (86.1%), 30 of 36 for DeepSeek (83.3%), and 29 of 36 for Doubao (80.6%).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the baseline accuracy, safety, readability, and empathy of four commercial LLMs answering caregiver pediatric burn questions without testing an organizational deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
